title: Successor Services Note: Takeover Allowance on a First Extension in Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases
content:
**Takeover days.** For the first extension on a Cedarline Summit loan's Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases case whose borrower has died, the successor's takeover days are the calendar days from the most recent accepted intent declaration on the case to the grant date.

**Rule.**

- Where the takeover days are no more than 7, 14 calendar days are added to the extension length for the successor taking over the sale or refinance.
- Where they are more than 7 and no more than 30, 7 calendar days are added to it.
- Where they are more than 30, or the case carries no accepted intent declaration, nothing is added.

The most recent accepted declaration is the one with the latest declaration date.

| Days from the most recent accepted declaration to the grant | Days added to the extension length |
|---|---|
| 0 to 7 | 14 |
| 8 to 30 | 7 |
| 31 or more | 0 |
| no accepted declaration on the case | 0 |

## Both sides (hypothetical; grant on 20 September)

- A declaration on 13 September is 7 days earlier: 14 days are added.
- A declaration on 12 September is 8 days earlier: 7 days are added.
- A declaration on 21 August is 30 days earlier: 7 days are added.
- A declaration on 20 August is 31 days earlier: nothing is added.
